title: Intersectional Fairness in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice stereotype association tests using the BBQ benchmark to measure bias scores (sDIS, sAMB) and subgroup fairness metrics (Statistical Parity, Differential Fairness) at the intersection of race/ethnicity with gender and socioeconomic status across ambiguous and disambiguated contexts.

Multiple-choice stereotype association tests using the BBQ benchmark to measure bias scores and subgroup fairness metrics at the intersection of gender and race/ethnicity across ambiguous and disambiguated contexts.

Multiple-choice stereotype association tests using the BBQ benchmark to measure bias scores and subgroup fairness metrics at the intersection of socioeconomic status (inferred via occupations) and race/ethnicity.
